questions.question: A workshop's owner describes one of her machinists as 'an intrapreneur'. Define the term 'intrapreneurship'. (2 marks)
A cabinetmaker earning $36,000 a year decides not to set up on her own, although she has the savings and the skills to do so. Explain one barrier to entrepreneurship that this suggests. (4 marks)

Altan Furniture is a small workshop making one design of wooden chair. Its fixed costs are $80,000 a year and each chair costs $10 to make. Demand is Q = 12,000 − 200P, where Q is chairs a year and P is the price in dollars. The founder decides to make 20 chairs on each of 200 working days rather than 25. Analyse this decision as an example of profit satisficing. (6 marks)

Altan Furniture is a small workshop making one design of wooden chair. Its fixed costs are $80,000 a year and each chair costs $10 to make. Demand is Q = 12,000 − 200P, where Q is chairs a year and P is the price in dollars. Calculate the price at which the workshop maximises profit, and the profit it earns there. (4 marks)

Altan Furniture is a small workshop making one design of wooden chair. Its fixed costs are $80,000 a year and each chair costs $10 to make. Demand is Q = 12,000 − 200P, where Q is chairs a year and P is the price in dollars. Construct a diagram showing the workshop's profit at each price, labelling the range within which it survives and the price at which profit is maximised. (4 marks)

Altan Furniture is a small workshop making one design of wooden chair. Its fixed costs are $80,000 a year and each chair costs $10 to make. Demand is Q = 12,000 − 200P, where Q is chairs a year and P is the price in dollars. A retailer offers to take 8,000 chairs a year if the workshop prices at $20. Assess whether the founder should accept in order to build market share. (10 marks)

A cabinetmaker can earn $36,000 managing a larger workshop, $24,000 taking a supplier's agency, or $18,000 working at the bench. She instead runs her own workshop, earning $45,000. Discuss whether this was the right decision. (8 marks)

Altan Furniture is a small workshop making one design of wooden chair. Its fixed costs are $80,000 a year and each chair costs $10 to make. Demand is Q = 12,000 − 200P, where Q is chairs a year and P is the price in dollars. Evaluate the view that a small business should always pursue profit maximisation. (20 marks)

leaves.requirement: Reasons why people set up businesses:
leaves.wording: financial motives: profit maximisation and profit satisficing

leaves.requirement: Reasons why people set up businesses:
leaves.wording: non-financial motives: ethical stance, social entrepreneurship, independence and home working.
